title: Reciprocal size of the orthogonal complement
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let a path on $\mathbb{F}_2^n$ specify values at some coordinates. The reciprocal of $2$ raised to the dimension of the orthogonal complement, under the standard dot product over $\mathbb{F}_2$, of the subspace of vectors vanishing on those coordinates equals $2^{-k}$, where $k$ is the number of coordinates specified by the path.
